002.name: Reimu
002.text: Ah, I think I've seen that bookshelf before.

003.name: Reimu
003.text:
Regardless, isn't this library much bigger 
			on the inside?

004.name: Reimu
004.text:
Looks like I found the right place when it comes to weird things
			happening.

005.text: It appears we have an unexpected guest.

009.name: Patchouli
009.text:
We have quiet hours in this library you know,
			which is every hour.

010.name: Patchouli
010.text:
And I heard you having a very loud fight with my familiar.
			Did you exorcise it?

011.name: Reimu
011.text:
Oh that was a demon? Looks like a did my job
			is destroying it then.

012.name: Patchouli
012.text:
What a bother. I'm out of summoning gems and my 
			dailys haven't refreshed yet.

013.name: Patchouli
013.text:
That was my favorite one too, it's going to take forever
			to get her back.

014.name: Reimu
014.text: Don't you have better things to do than rerolling your Makai pulls.

015.name: Reimu
015.text: Like eating cake or something. Or can your ass not get any fatter.

016.name: Patchouli
016.text:
I'm sure you have more important business than breaking and 
			entering then zapping my assistants and insulting me.

017.name: Reimu
017.text: Uh right. So about that red mist...

018.name: Patchouli
018.text:
All Remilia's fault. I told her it was a bad idea and that 
			someone like you would show up. Along with who knows what else
			if this continues.

019.name: Reimu
019.text: Great, so I can get going then.

021.name: Patchouli
021.text:
Now hold on, I still need you to pay up. I'm
			impaitient and summoning gems aren't cheap.

022.name: Reimu
022.text: Er, I don't have any money right now.

023.name: Patchouli
023.text: Well I can always recycle your body for material...
